acceptanceCriteria: Reuse-key observation cost is independent of each checkout's tracked-file count or explicitly bounded (stat-only index checks or a cached status digest).
Pinned-revision verification is skipped or amortised while the reuse key is unchanged.
The DCP-V1-281 acceptance fixture includes a checkout with more than 10,000 tracked files and meets median freshness_ms < 100 and p95 total_ms < 1 s.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1554 (1.0.0-rc.3, main 6e90476). With 4 additional repositories (13,806/3,111/450/274 tracked files, 9,170 pinned inputs), 93 warm tools/call requests reuse freshness but freshness_ms is median 1,042 ms (max 2,125) and verify_ms mean 339; p95 total_ms 1,945. git status --porcelain on the largest checkout is 0.22 s warm. DCP-V1-281 (median freshness_ms < 100, p95 total_ms < 1 s at >= 8,000 pinned inputs) holds on the fixture only; cost scales with checkout size. Follow-up to V1-2328 (GH #1487).
title: GH #1554: corpus MCP reuse-key freshness still costs ~1 s per warm call on large additional-repository checkouts
